```plato

// Brown-Conrady lens distortion coefficients: K1, K2, and K3 are radial terms;
// P1 and P2 are tangential (decentering) terms. All zero means an ideal lens.
// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distortion_(optics).
type LensDistortion
    implements IValue
{
    K1: Number;
    K2: Number;
    K3: Number;
    P1: Number;
    P2: Number;
}
```
